note: The IFC and Arab Monetary Fund's Arab Credit Reporting Guide (2015) on the Banque du Liban's credit registry: finance and microfinance institutions report to it monthly, with no threshold, written as 30 days, and its data is never erased, written as thirty years, the longest the game keeps; registered as secondary, the Banque du Liban's own circulars not read.

sources.title: IFC and Arab Monetary Fund, Arab Credit Reporting Guide (2015)
sources.said: All finance and microfinance ... institutions report data to the CR on a monthly basis. ... There is no time limit for the ... preservation of data, which is never erased from the CR.
